_comment: Right-click context help, transcribed from BILLHELP::_technology_change_help_list (billhelp.cpp:48-52, 3 entries, s_help_box {help_id, x1, y1, x2, y2} orion2.h:993), installed by BILLHELP::Technology_Change_Help_ (billhelp.cpp:122) and RE-INSTALLED on every redraw from tech.cpp:278-283. All three carry the SAME id, 255 - the change panel has one help entry and three rectangles for it, and all three lie OUTSIDE the panel. Inside the panel a right click is NOT help: it opens the description box for the choice under the pointer (tech.cpp:323-337). `native` is the original's 640x480 rectangle and is the provenance; the HD region is resolved from the named box, as on every other screen. NOTE the shape differs from select mode's: change mode's panel sits 81 px further left, so its bands are LEFT, RIGHT and TOP where select mode's are the science room, TOP and BOTTOM.
hd_extension: The help popup auto-sizes to its text and scrolls when it cannot fit. The original draws a fixed box and lets FMTPARA wrap into it at a fixed 339 px (TEXTBOX::Draw_Help_Entry_, textbox.cpp:307); at four HD resolutions a fixed box either wastes half the screen on two lines or clips a long entry. Marked once per file, here, and in core/helppopup.py.
